name: new_v2_seven_qualified_axis_envelope_with_external_rest_speed_v1
speed_axis: Pooled macro-F1 across native slow, medium and fast MANUS trial labels in each held-out session, with a source-only ROAM Myo Rest-noise prior; retain worst speed and subject-speed separately
aggregation: unweighted descriptive mean and minimum of seven heterogenous axis-specific macro-F1 values; preserve minimum source observation cell separately
selection: Report all arms and validation/final; do not use already-inspected final sessions to revise prior cross-axis or native MANUS validation selections
boundary: The speed coordinate has a cross-dataset Rest prior and evaluates seen speed categories in a changed session, not unseen-speed transfer. Quality is synthetic, not measured hardware quality. Quality/posture share ROAM users; day/user share GRABMyo records; other axes have different classes/rates/devices. Seven-axis equal mean is descriptive only, with real hardware quality and own 250 Hz device performance still N/A.
